name: record-field
body: An inline nested record field type declared as a list item (`item: {type: record, fields: [...]}`) or as a field: a record's `fields:` uses the same descriptors as a template's top-level fields, so it nests records and lists and may carry `nullable` fields. Its value is a YAML mapping validated recursively against its `fields:`, with a violation reported by full path (e.g. `items › [2] › value: …`). In layouts a record's `text` fields are pre-rendered and its other fields arrive typed, exactly like top-level fields.
